title: Files drive: transport adapter
description: One protocol over loopback, mesh, relay or gateway.

TransportKind.description: loopback = same machine (Desktop app to its own runtime). mesh = Headscale/tsnet, only between the user's own devices. relay = cloud-api POST /api/v1/runtime-devices/:id/proxy (RelayRequest envelope; the Files path goes in `path`); the baseline that always exists. gateway = cloud-api Files gateway for guests holding a share capability token.

base_url.description: loopback/mesh: URL prefix ending in /api/v1/files/v2. relay: the proxy URL; the client sends {method, path: "/api/v1/files/v2/...", headers, body, body_encoding} to it. gateway: https://api.allternit.com/api/v1/files-gateway.

max_request_bytes.description: Largest request body this transport takes, in decoded bytes. relay = 5242880 (runtime_relay.rs MAX_RELAY_BODY_BYTES; base64 bodies are measured as len*3/4). Chunks are at most 4194304, so one chunk always fits.

mesh_hostname.description: Only for own_device hosts on the mesh.

host.description: cloud_computer = provisioned by cloud-api (Incus/Contabo/Orgo). These computers do not join the mesh, so the server never lists a mesh candidate for them: relay only.

EndpointsResponse.description: GET /api/v1/computer-files/:computer_id/endpoints on cloud-api. Candidates sorted by priority; the client tries them in order (see SPEC.md 'Replica and transport resolution').
